name: LocationIQ Geocoding API
best_for: commercial hosted alternative to public Nominatim or self-hosted Nominatim

pricing.free_plan: 5000 requests/day; 2 requests/second; 60 requests/minute; limited commercial use with attribution
pricing.enterprise: custom pricing, custom request rates, custom contract and SLAs
pricing.notes: Maps Lite plan wording needs confirmation before treating it as a geocoding production plan.

authentication.notes: API reference says each API or map-tile request must be authenticated with an access token.

sandbox.free_plan: 5000 requests/day on the public Free plan
sandbox.notes: No Atlas credentialed live test was performed.

rate_limits.overage: pricing FAQ says exceeding credits can return HTTP 429 and persistent excess requires a higher plan

openapi.notes: Docs landing page says endpoint material is available for AI agents in OpenAPI; Atlas did not capture a standalone OpenAPI file.

coverage.data_model: multiple public and proprietary datasets according to API reference; OpenStreetMap-compatible response concepts and attribution fields appear in docs

data_rights.attribution: free_plan_commercial_use_requires LocationIQ attribution according to pricing FAQ

open_questions: Legal treatment of ODbL, attribution, derived databases, redistribution and SaaS use for the intended product
Exact enterprise SLA/support terms and whether custom SLA is available for the target plan
Whether LocationIQ Nearby POI is sufficient for the target place-search scenario or a separate places provider is needed
Benchmark quality for target countries, languages, house-level precision, autocomplete relevance and latency
Whether large-batch processing by LocationIQ is available under acceptable price, privacy and evidence terms
DPA/privacy requirements for submitted addresses and coordinates
Whether Maps Lite plan can be used for the intended geocoding workload or is maps-focused
